title: Sign up for Training Event Announcements and More
content: Training News 2026 &nbspPrevious Article Next Article Sign up for Training Event Announcements and More 11/04 RCSB PDB publishes different newsletters and hosts mailing lists to provide updates and announcements: Sign up for Training Event Announcements : Email list for upcoming webinars and office hours Quarterly newsletter describes activities across all RCSB PDB services: Deposition/Biocuration; Archive Management/Access; Data Exploration; and Training/Outreach ( Archive | Subscribe ) Molecule of the Month Newsletter reveals each month's featured structural story along with related PDB-101 news ( Subscribe ) Stay up-to-date with API developments by viewing (or subscribing) to the RCSB PDB API announcements Google group pdb-l@lists.wwpdb.org is an open discussion forum for questions and discussions with the PDB user community about protein structure, analysis, and related topics ( Archive | Subscribe ) MyPDB allows users to save any type of structure search (e.g., keyword, sequence, composite query). Users can run these searches at any time, and receive email alerts when matching structures are released. Weekly news is posted on the RCSB.org home page Like and subscribe to RCSB PDB's YouTube Channel Follow RCSB PDB on LinkedIn , Bluesky , Facebook , and Twitter/X The RCSB PDB newsletter is published quarterly. Future Training Events Sign up for to receive notifications in your email. Sign Up for Newsletter Past Training Events Watch recorded seminars and courses on PDB-101 or go our YouTube channel to watch Office Hour presentations.
